[SWS_CM_01012].
7.5.23.2 Service Method Application Errors Header Files
The
Service Method Application Errors Header Files
are the language
bindings of
ApApplicationError
s generated by a workflow tool from a
PortIn-
terface
. The processing rules of how the
ARA Language Binding Generator
shall create these, are specified in [16].
7.6 Functional cluster lifecycle
The Communication Management functional cluster provides the primary communica-
tion infrastructure for Adaptive AUTOSAR, which is used by State Management. Be-
cause the interaction between State Management and Execution Management has a
key impact on the lifecycle of the entire Adaptive AUTOSAR platform, the availability
of communication infrastructure is essential for system state changes. AUTOSAR as-
sumes the availability of this communication in the states Startup and Shutdown to the
extent necessary to perform these states.
7.6.1 Startup
No special startup handling is needed for the Communication Management functional
cluster. However, Communication Management provides the communication infras-
tructure used by State Management. Therefore, it is recommended to start Communi-
cation Management in parallel with Execution Management or after starting Execution
Management but before starting State Management. Once State Management and Ex-
ecution Management are operational, they should take control of the Communication
Management lifecycle.
